question: After rebasing onto current `main`, should the approved two-database Apple migration land with its legacy-import and gateway-cleanup contract intact?
rationale: This PR changes persisted client state across two Apple applications; the product direction is approved, but acceptance of the exact upgrade behavior remains an accountable maintainer decision.

options.title: Review rebased migration and land
options.body: Rebase onto current `main`, re-run the focused storage upgrade and gateway-isolation proof against the exact merge result, then land if the durable-state contract remains intact.

options.title: Pause for narrower migration review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want additional production-state fixtures or a staged rollout before replacing the existing Apple offline stores.

recommendation.title: Review rebased migration and land
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current `main`, re-run the focused storage upgrade and gateway-isolation proof against the exact merge result, then land if the durable-state contract remains intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion attributes the Apple-first persistence contract decision to steipete and the branch implements that approved boundary.
